name: Status Page
description: A public status page with 90-day uptime bars, a day you can point at, the current incident as a timeline, and subscribe that becomes a check.

props.name: product
props.description: Product name in the header, in mono beside the status dot.

props.name: state
props.description: Overall condition. It chooses the headline, the bars and the incident.

props.name: showBars
props.description: Draw the 90-day bars under each component.

props.name: accent
props.description: The degraded signal: the status dot, the Degraded label, degraded days, and the latest incident mark. The day under the pointer is ink. Up and down stay semantic.

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Called with the address when subscribe succeeds.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root section.
